admission.justification: A complete classified advertisement joins registrar enforcement and the central declarations; otherwise an omitted/mistyped hint can imply purity for a tool capable of report/capture/freshness writes.

applicability: Annotations on the complete registered public MCP tool surface.
conditions: Annotation application follows registration from the product factory.
exclusions: Treating readOnlyHint as sandbox permissions, global runtime purity, semantic approval or proof that a test ran.
Restoring the removed public resolve_context tool.

evidence: l109e-helper-epoch-source-deltas.json; current source-owner cards and the exact successor native plan

statement: Every registered public tool receives its readOnlyHint from the central read-only classification; an unclassified registration refuses. The hint describes declared capability, not a semantic verdict or proof of host-wide purity: knowledge_diff report/capture and context_packet freshness capability are marked false, while the two naming readers read_ar_files and knowledge_read are marked true.
